title: Can a special education teacher provide Speech Therapy for children with Autism?
metaTitle: Speech Therapy vs Special Education in Autism Treatment | Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn why speech therapy, conducted by professional Speech-Language Pathologists like those at Pinnacle Blooms Network, is a fundamental part of Autism treatment.
html: While special education teachers are exceptional in their role, they typically don't provide speech therapy for children with Autism. However, at Pinnacle Blooms Network, we have a team of highly trained and professional Speech-Language Pathologists who specialize in delivering cutting-edge, effective speech therapy services tailored to your child's needs.
